title: RMB Ultra-trail Cape Town — official 2026 event page
claims: The 2026 event runs 20–22 November and offers six distances: 100 miler, 100 km, 55 km, 35 km, 23 km and 16 km.
The UTCT 100 miler runs from the northern mountain range to the southern mountains via Silvermine, Kalk Bay, Kommetjie and Simonstown, with 7,516 m of vertical gain.
The organiser says weather can vary drastically in late November, from single-digit temperatures on top of Table Mountain to more than 30 °C later in the day.
The event describes all six races as genuine mountain excursions over highly technical trails in Table Mountain National Park.
The official 2026 event home page provides TRACKING and LIVE BROADCAST entry points for the race weekend.
The official 2026 pages title the event 'RMB Ultra-trail Cape Town' with RMB as title sponsor; no 'by UTMB' branding and no UTMB Group acquisition announcement appear on the pages read.

verification.note: 2026-11-20 经本机 7890 代理读取官方赛事页，除日期、组别、100 英里 7,516 m 与天气描述外，首页还提供 TRACKING 与 LIVE BROADCAST 入口。
